name: Fate of China - Emergency Action
text: The year is 2050, our glorious nation, the people's republic of China were in a nuclear war. Luckily, our forefathers constructed a series of defence officially called 'The Third Line Construction' in the 1970s. Nicknamed [The Underground Great Wall]. It was constantly maintenaned and expanded under tense international conflicts up until the final moment. We have been relying on these legacy for about 20 years. Until now, the radiation level has gone down remarkablly and we need to bear the responsibility of raising the red flag again.

name: Fate of China - Vault Door Opens
text: After all the decisions has been set. Li De Sheng. Current Party Chairman of [The Underground Great Wall] facility let out a long sign. There are still a long way to go recovering lost territories and past glory is meaningless in the face of the brutal reality. He glimpsed at the wall behind him. Where the the photo of Marx, Engles, Lenin, Mao Ze Dong resides.
